description: An Apache Arrow Flight SQL gateway for relational databases: clients speak Flight SQL, the gateway runs their queries through ODBC or an ADO.NET provider and streams the results back compressed. Runs as a Windows service.
notes: Settings live in %ProgramData%\DbDataGateway\config (server.yaml, gateway/, connections/). The state database is a SQLite file in the data directory (the 'service' topology, no setup); for a group or install database see: dbdatagateway state init. Registering the Windows service needs an elevated prompt: dbdatagateway service install
